description: Gebiete für grosse Windkraftanlagen, Richtplan is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by AGIS Service Center Kanton Aargau. (Vergleiche Richtplankapitel E.1.3, Windkraftanlagen, Planungsgrundsatz A). Coverage: AGIS Service Center Kanton Aargau. The portal files it under the publisher AGIS Service Center Kanton Aargau. It offers 2 resource(s) in WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
